当前文件夹中是一个OpenVela Vendor Overlay工程，在这里修改的代码会自动软链接到/home/lxy/openvela/vendor/espressif，并且加入编译。
编译时，会自动拉取依赖放到
/home/lxy/openvela/cmake_out/esp32p4-function-ev-board_esp_hosted/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif
并且自动添加头文件目录等，因此你可以直接include其中的头文件。
在/home/lxy/openvela/nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32s3里面，有一些较为完善的ESP32-S3BSP。注意：ESP32P4是Risc-V架构，代码逻辑、DMA、GPIO交换矩阵等和ESP32S3有很大区别，因此不能直接照搬ESP32S3的代码逻辑，需要根据esp-hal-3rdparty里面的相关代码，实现ESP32-P4的BSP。
nuttx其它文件位于：/home/lxy/openvela/nuttx
现在需要你基于上述资料，分析并实现ESP32P4的SDIO支持。
注意：在编写代码时，只能修改位于当前文件夹中的代码：/home/lxy/openvela/contest2026_128_xiaolidianzishiyanshi
不能修改其它文件夹中的代码。如果只修改当前文件夹中的代码无法实现目标需求，或者需要进行不符合编码规范的动作（Workaround）时，应当立即停止实现，并报告原因，由用户决定下一步的实现方向。
只需要考虑CMake构建系统，不需要考虑传统的Makefile
ESP32P4有2个SDIO接口，一个用于连接外置TF卡，另一个用来通过ESP-Hosted-MCU协议与板载ESP32-C6通信。
我正在移植ESP-Hosted-MCU协议，现在需要补全ESP32-P4的SDIO接口层支持。.现在chip层已有SDMMC和esp-hosted代码，但board层还没有调用这些。你分析并添加board层调用，但暂时不编译。

370	/****************************************************************************
371	 * Name: esp32p4_getreg
372	 *
373	 * Description:
374	 *   This function may to used to intercept an monitor all register accesses.
375	 *   Clearly this is nothing you would want to do unless you are debugging
376	 *   this driver.
377	 *
378	 * Input Parameters:
379	 *   addr - The register address to read
380	 *
381	 * Returned Value:
382	 *   The value read from the register
383	 *
384	 ****************************************************************************/
385	
386	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_REGDEBUG
387	static uint32_t __esp32p4_getreg(const char* func, uint32_t addr) {
388	  static uint32_t prevaddr = 0;
389	  static uint32_t preval = 0;
390	  static uint32_t count = 0;
391	
392	  /* Read the value from the register */
393	
394	  uint32_t val = getreg32(addr);
395	
396	  /* Is this the same value that we read from the same register last time?
397	   * Are we polling the register?  If so, suppress some of the output.
398	   */
399	
400	  if (addr == prevaddr && val == preval) {
401	    if (count == 0xffffffff || ++count > 3) {
402	      if (count == 4) {
403	        mcerr("%s: ...\n", func);
404	      }
405	
406	      return val;
407	    }
408	  }
409	
410	  /* No this is a new address or value */
411	
412	  else {
413	    /* Did we print "..." for the previous value? */
414	
415	    if (count > 3) {
416	      /* Yes.. then show how many times the value repeated */
417	
418	      mcerr("%s: [repeats %d more times]\n", func, count - 3);
419	    }
420	
421	    /* Save the new address, value, and count */
422	
423	    prevaddr = addr;
424	    preval = val;
425	    count = 1;
426	  }
427	
428	  /* Show the register value read */
429	
430	  mcerr("%s: %08x->%08x\n", func, addr, val);
431	  return val;
432	}
433	#endif

464	/****************************************************************************
465	 * Name: esp32p4_ciu_sendcmd
466	 *
467	 * Description:
468	 *   Function to send command to Card interface unit (CIU)
469	 *
470	 * Input Parameters:
471	 *   cmd - The command to be executed
472	 *   arg - The argument to use with the command.
473	 *
474	 * Returned Value:
475	 *   Returns zero on success.  One will be returned on a timeout.
476	 *
477	 ****************************************************************************/
478	
479	static int esp32p4_ciu_sendcmd(uint32_t cmd, uint32_t arg)
480	{
481	  sdmmc_hw_cmd_t cmd_val;
482	  clock_t watchtime;
483	
484	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
485	
486	  /* Wait for previous command to be taken by CIU */
487	
488	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_command_taken(&SDMMC))
489	    {
490	      if (clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
491	        {
492	          mcerr("TMO Timed out waiting for command taken (%08" PRIx32 ")\n",
493	                SDMMC.cmd.val);
494	          return 1;
495	        }
496	    }
497	
498	  /* Build the command register value from NuttX command encoding */
499	
500	  memset(&cmd_val, 0, sizeof(cmd_val));
501	
502	  /* Command index (bits 0-5) */
503	
504	  cmd_val.cmd_index = (cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) >> MMCSD_CMDIDX_SHIFT;
505	
506	  /* Response type (bits 6-9) */
507	
508	  uint32_t resp = (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT;
509	
510	  switch (resp)
511	    {
512	      case MMCSD_NO_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
513	        /* No response */
514	        break;
515	
516	      case MMCSD_R1_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
517	      case MMCSD_R1B_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
518	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
519	        cmd_val.check_response_crc = 1;
520	        break;
521	
522	      case MMCSD_R2_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
523	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
524	        cmd_val.response_long = 1;
525	        cmd_val.check_response_crc = 1;
526	        break;
527	
528	      case MMCSD_R3_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
529	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
530	        /* R3 has no CRC */
531	        break;
532	
533	      case MMCSD_R4_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
534	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
535	        break;
536	
537	      case MMCSD_R5_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
538	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
539	        cmd_val.check_response_crc = 1;
540	        break;
541	
542	      case MMCSD_R6_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
543	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
544	        cmd_val.check_response_crc = 1;
545	        break;
546	
547	      case MMCSD_R7_RESPONSE >> MMCSD_RESPONSE_SHIFT:
548	        cmd_val.response_expect = 1;
549	        break;
550	
551	      default:
552	        mcerr("ERROR: Unknown response type: %" PRIx32 "\n", resp);
553	        break;
554	    }
555	
556	  /* Data transfer (bits 10-12) */
557	
558	  uint32_t xfr = (cmd & MMCSD_DATAXFR_MASK) >> MMCSD_DATAXFR_SHIFT;
559	
560	  if (xfr != 0)
561	    {
562	      cmd_val.data_expected = 1;
563	
564	      if (cmd & MMCSD_WRXFR)
565	        {
566	          cmd_val.rw = 1;  /* Write */
567	        }
568	
569	      if (cmd & MMCSD_STREAM)
570	        {
571	          cmd_val.transfer_mode = 1;  /* Stream mode */
572	        }
573	    }
574	
575	  /* Send auto stop for multiblock transfers */
576	
577	  if (cmd & MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK)
578	    {
579	      /* Don't send auto-stop; we'll send CMD12 manually */
580	
581	      cmd_val.send_auto_stop = 0;
582	    }
583	
584	  if (cmd & MMCSD_STOPXFR)
585	    {
586	      cmd_val.stop_abort_cmd = 1;
587	    }
588	
589	  /* Wait for previous data transfer to complete */
590	
591	  cmd_val.wait_complete = 1;
592	
593	  /* Send initialization sequence (80 clocks) for CMD0 */
594	
595	  if ((cmd & MMCSD_CMDIDX_MASK) == 0)
596	    {
597	      /* Don't send init sequence here, it's handled separately */
598	
599	      cmd_val.send_init = 0;
600	    }
601	
602	  /* Use hold register for synchronization */
603	
604	  cmd_val.use_hold_reg = 1;
605	
606	  /* Set card number */
607	
608	  cmd_val.card_num = 0;
609	
610	  /* Start command */
611	
612	  cmd_val.start_command = 1;
613	
614	  /* Set argument and send command */
615	
616	  sdmmc_ll_set_command_arg(&SDMMC, arg);
617	  sdmmc_ll_set_command(&SDMMC, cmd_val);
618	
619	  mcinfo("cmd=0x%" PRIx32 " arg=0x%" PRIx32 " cmd_val=0x%" PRIx32 "\n",
620	         cmd, arg, (uint32_t)cmd_val.val);
621	
622	  return 0;
623	}

674	  uint32_t regval;
675	
676	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
677	  mcinfo("waitmask=%04" PRIx32 " xfrmask=%04" PRIx32 " dmamask=%04" PRIx32

686	         (uint32_t)sdmmc_ll_get_interrupt_raw(&SDMMC));

726	/****************************************************************************
727	 * Name: esp32p4_config_waitints
728	 *
729	 * Description:
730	 *   Enable/disable SD card interrupts needed to support the wait function
731	 *
732	 * Input Parameters:
733	 *   priv       - A reference to the SD card device state structure
734	 *   waitmask   - The set of bits in the SD card INTMASK register to set
735	 *   waitevents - Waited for events
736	 *   wkupevent  - Wake-up events
737	 *
738	 * Returned Value:
739	 *   None
740	 *
741	 ****************************************************************************/
742	
743	static void esp32p4_config_waitints(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv,
744	                                    uint32_t waitmask,
745	                                    sdio_eventset_t waitevents,
746	                                    sdio_eventset_t wkupevent)
747	{
748	  irqstate_t flags;
749	
750	  mcinfo("waitevents=%04x wkupevent=%04x\n",
751	         (unsigned)waitevents, (unsigned)wkupevent);
752	
753	  /* Save all of the data and set the new interrupt mask in one, atomic
754	   * operation.
755	   */
756	
757	  flags            = enter_critical_section();
758	  priv->waitevents = waitevents;
759	  priv->wkupevent  = wkupevent;
760	  priv->waitmask   = waitmask;
761	
762	  esp32p4_enable_ints(priv);
763	  leave_critical_section(flags);
764	}

793	/****************************************************************************
794	 * Name: esp32p4_eventtimeout
795	 *
796	 * Description:
797	 *   The watchdog timeout setup when the event wait start has expired without
798	 *   any other waited-for event occurring.
799	 *
800	 * Input Parameters:
801	 *   arg    - The argument
802	 *
803	 * Returned Value:
804	 *   None
805	 *
806	 * Assumptions:
807	 *   Always called from the interrupt level with interrupts disabled.
808	 *
809	 ****************************************************************************/
810	
811	static void esp32p4_eventtimeout(wdparm_t arg)
812	{
813	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)arg;
814	
815	  /* There is always race conditions with timer expirations. */
816	
817	  DEBUGASSERT((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT) != 0 ||
818	              priv->wkupevent != 0);
819	
820	  /* Is a data transfer complete event expected? */
821	
822	  if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT) != 0)
823	    {
824	      /* Yes.. wake up any waiting threads */
825	
826	      esp32p4_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT);
827	      mcerr("Timeout: remaining: %d\n", priv->remaining);
828	    }
829	}
830	
831	/****************************************************************************
832	 * Name: esp32p4_endwait
833	 *
834	 * Description:
835	 *   Wake up a waiting thread if the waited-for event has occurred.
836	 *
837	 * Input Parameters:
838	 *   priv      - An instance of the SDIO device interface
839	 *   wkupevent - The event that caused the wait to end
840	 *
841	 * Returned Value:
842	 *   None
843	 *
844	 * Assumptions:
845	 *   Always called from the interrupt level with interrupts disabled.
846	 *
847	 ****************************************************************************/
848	
849	static void esp32p4_endwait(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv,
850	                            sdio_eventset_t wkupevent)
851	{
852	  mcinfo("wkupevent=%04x\n", (unsigned)wkupevent);
853	
854	  /* Cancel the watchdog timeout */
855	
856	  wd_cancel(&priv->waitwdog);
857	
858	  /* Disable event-related interrupts */
859	
860	  esp32p4_config_waitints(priv, 0, 0, wkupevent);
861	
862	  /* Wake up the waiting thread */
863	
864	  nxsem_post(&priv->waitsem);
865	}

867	/****************************************************************************
868	 * Name: esp32p4_endtransfer
869	 *
870	 * Description:
871	 *   Terminate a transfer with the provided status.  This function is called
872	 *   only from the SDIO interrupt handler when end-of-transfer conditions
873	 *   are detected.
874	 *
875	 * Input Parameters:
876	 *   priv   - An instance of the SDIO device interface
877	 *   wkupevent - The event that caused the transfer to end
878	 *
879	 * Returned Value:
880	 *   None
881	 *
882	 * Assumptions:
883	 *   Always called from the interrupt level with interrupts disabled.
884	 *
885	 ****************************************************************************/
886	
887	static void esp32p4_endtransfer(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv,
888	                                sdio_eventset_t wkupevent)
889	{
890	  mcinfo("wkupevent=%04x\n", (unsigned)wkupevent);
891	
892	  /* Disable all transfer related interrupts */
893	
894	  esp32p4_config_xfrints(priv, 0);
895	
896	  /* Clearing pending interrupt status on all transfer related interrupts */
897	
898	  sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, priv->waitmask);
899	
900	  /* Mark the transfer finished */
901	
902	  priv->remaining = 0;
903	
904	  /* Is a thread wait for these data transfer complete events? */
905	
906	  if ((priv->waitevents & wkupevent) != 0)
907	    {
908	      /* Yes.. wake up any waiting threads */
909	
910	      esp32p4_endwait(priv, wkupevent);
911	    }
912	}

914	/****************************************************************************
915	 * Name: esp32p4_interrupt
916	 *
917	 * Description:
918	 *   SDIO interrupt handler
919	 *
920	 * Input Parameters:
921	 *   dev - An instance of the SDIO device interface
922	 *
923	 * Returned Value:
924	 *   None
925	 *
926	 ****************************************************************************/
927	
928	static int esp32p4_interrupt(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
929	{
930	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = arg;
931	  uint32_t enabled;
932	  uint32_t pending;
933	
934	  /* Loop while there are pending interrupts.  Check the SD card status
935	   * register.  Mask out all bits that don't correspond to enabled
936	   * interrupts.  (This depends on the fact that bits are ordered
937	   * the same in both the STA and MASK register).  If there are non-zero
938	   * bits remaining, then we have work to do here.
939	   */
940	
941	  while ((enabled = sdmmc_ll_get_intr_status(&SDMMC)) != 0)
942	    {
943	      /* Clear pending status */
944	
945	      sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, enabled);
946	
947	#ifdef CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_CARDDETECT
948	      /* Handle in card detection events ************************************/
949	
950	      if ((enabled & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CD) != 0)
951	        {
952	          sdio_statset_t cdstatus;
953	
954	          /* Update card status */
955	
956	          cdstatus = priv->cdstatus;
957	          if (!sdmmc_ll_is_card_detected(&SDMMC, priv->slot))
958	            {
959	              priv->cdstatus |= SDIO_STATUS_PRESENT;
960	
961	#ifdef CONFIG_MMCSD_HAVE_WRITEPROTECT
962	              if (sdmmc_ll_is_card_write_protected(&SDMMC, priv->slot))
963	                {
964	                  priv->cdstatus |= SDIO_STATUS_WRPROTECTED;
965	                }
966	              else
967	#endif
968	                {
969	                  priv->cdstatus &= ~SDIO_STATUS_WRPROTECTED;
970	                }
971	            }
972	          else
973	            {
974	              priv->cdstatus &=
975	                ~(SDIO_STATUS_PRESENT | SDIO_STATUS_WRPROTECTED);
976	            }
977	
978	          mcinfo("cdstatus OLD: %02x NEW: %02x\n", cdstatus, priv->cdstatus);
979	
980	          /* Perform any requested callback if the status has changed */
981	
982	          if (cdstatus != priv->cdstatus)
983	            {
984	              esp32p4_callback(priv);
985	            }
986	        }
987	#endif
988	
989	      /* Handle data transfer events ****************************************/
990	
991	      pending = enabled & priv->xfrmask;
992	      if (pending != 0)
993	        {
994	          /* Handle data request events */
995	
996	          if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_TXDR) != 0)
997	            {
998	              /* Transfer data to the TX FIFO */
999	
1000	              DEBUGASSERT(priv->wrdir);
1001	
1002	              while (!SDMMC.status.fifo_full && priv->remaining > 0)
1003	                {
1004	                  SDMMC.buffifo.val = *priv->buffer;
1005	                  priv->buffer++;
1006	                  priv->remaining -= 4;
1007	                }
1008	            }
1009	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RXDR) != 0)
1010	            {
1011	              /* Transfer data from the RX FIFO */
1012	
1013	              DEBUGASSERT(!priv->wrdir);
1014	
1015	              while (!SDMMC.status.fifo_empty && priv->remaining > 0)
1016	                {
1017	                  *priv->buffer = SDMMC.buffifo.val;
1018	                  priv->buffer++;
1019	                  priv->remaining -= 4;
1020	                }
1021	            }
1022	
1023	          /* Check for transfer errors */
1024	
1025	          /* Handle data block send/receive CRC failure */
1026	
1027	          if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DCRC) != 0)
1028	            {
1029	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1030	
1031	              mcerr("ERROR: Data CRC failure, pending=%08" PRIx32
1032	                    " remaining: %d\n", pending, priv->remaining);
1033	
1034	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv,
1035	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1036	            }
1037	
1038	          /* Handle data timeout error */
1039	
1040	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RTO) != 0)
1041	            {
1042	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1043	
1044	              mcerr("ERROR: Data timeout, pending=%08" PRIx32
1045	                    " remaining: %d\n", pending, priv->remaining);
1046	
1047	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv,
1048	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT);
1049	            }
1050	
1051	          /* Handle RX FIFO overrun error */
1052	
1053	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_FRUN) != 0)
1054	            {
1055	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1056	
1057	              mcerr("ERROR: RX FIFO overrun, pending=%08" PRIx32
1058	                    " remaining: %d\n", pending, priv->remaining);
1059	
1060	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv,
1061	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1062	            }
1063	
1064	          /* Handle start bit error */
1065	
1066	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_SBE) != 0)
1067	            {
1068	              /* Terminate the transfer with an error */
1069	
1070	              mcerr("ERROR: Start bit, pending=%08" PRIx32
1071	                    " remaining: %d\n", pending, priv->remaining);
1072	
1073	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv,
1074	                                  SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1075	            }
1076	
1077	          /* Handle data end events.  Note that RXDR may accompany DTO, DTO
1078	           * will be set on received while there is still data in the FIFO.
1079	           * So for the case of receiving, we don't actually even enable the
1080	           * DTO interrupt.
1081	           */
1082	
1083	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DTO) != 0)
1084	            {
1085	              /* Finish the transfer */
1086	
1087	              esp32p4_endtransfer(priv, SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE);
1088	            }
1089	        }
1090	
1091	      /* Handle wait events *************************************************/
1092	
1093	      pending = enabled & priv->waitmask;
1094	      if (pending != 0)
1095	        {
1096	          /* Is this a response error event? */
1097	
1098	          if ((pending & SDCARD_INT_RESPERR) != 0)
1099	            {
1100	              /* If response errors are enabled, then we must certainly be
1101	               * waiting for a response.
1102	               */
1103	
1104	              DEBUGASSERT((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) != 0);
1105	
1106	              /* Wake the thread up */
1107	
1108	              mcerr("ERROR: Response error, pending=%08" PRIx32 "\n", pending);
1109	              esp32p4_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1110	            }
1111	
1112	          /* Is this a command (plus response) completion event? */
1113	
1114	          else if ((pending & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE) != 0)
1115	            {
1116	              /* Yes.. Is their a thread waiting for response done? */
1117	
1118	              if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) != 0)
1119	                {
1120	                  /* Yes.. wake the thread up */
1121	
1122	                  esp32p4_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE);
1123	                }
1124	
1125	              /* NO.. Is their a thread waiting for command done? */
1126	
1127	              else if ((priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE) != 0)
1128	                {
1129	                  /* Yes.. wake the thread up */
1130	
1131	                  esp32p4_endwait(priv, SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE);
1132	                }
1133	            }
1134	        }
1135	    }
1136	
1137	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
1138	  /* DMA error events *******************************************************/
1139	
1140	  pending = sdmmc_ll_get_idsts_interrupt_raw(&SDMMC);
1141	  if ((pending & priv->dmamask) != 0)
1142	    {
1143	      mcerr("ERROR: IDTS=%08" PRIx32 "\n", (uint32_t)pending);
1144	
1145	      /* Clear the pending interrupts */
1146	
1147	      sdmmc_ll_clear_idsts_interrupt(&SDMMC, pending);
1148	
1149	      /* Abort the transfer */
1150	
1151	      esp32p4_endtransfer(priv, SDIOWAIT_TRANSFERDONE | SDIOWAIT_ERROR);
1152	    }
1153	#endif
1154	
1155	  return OK;
1156	}

1189	/****************************************************************************
1190	 * Name: esp32p4_reset
1191	 *
1192	 * Description:
1193	 *   Reset the SDIO controller.  Undo all setup and initialization.
1194	 *
1195	 * Input Parameters:
1196	 *   dev    - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1197	 *
1198	 * Returned Value:
1199	 *   None
1200	 *
1201	 ****************************************************************************/
1202	
1203	static void esp32p4_reset(struct sdio_dev_s *dev)
1204	{
1205	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
1206	  irqstate_t flags;
1207	
1208	  mcinfo("Resetting...\n");
1209	
1210	  flags = enter_critical_section();
1211	
1212	  /* Reset all blocks */
1213	
1214	  sdmmc_ll_reset_controller(&SDMMC);
1215	  sdmmc_ll_reset_dma(&SDMMC);
1216	  sdmmc_ll_reset_fifo(&SDMMC);
1217	
1218	  /* Wait for reset to complete */
1219	
1220	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_controller_reset_done(&SDMMC) ||
1221	         !sdmmc_ll_is_dma_reset_done(&SDMMC) ||
1222	         !sdmmc_ll_is_fifo_reset_done(&SDMMC))
1223	    {
1224	    }
1225	
1226	  /* Initialize phase delays and set card clock divider */
1227	
1228	  SDMMC_RCC_ATOMIC()
1229	    {
1230	      sdmmc_ll_init_phase_delay(&SDMMC);
1231	      sdmmc_ll_set_card_clock_div(&SDMMC, priv->slot, priv->slot);
1232	    }
1233	
1234	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
1235	  sdmmc_ll_set_desc_addr(&SDMMC, (uint32_t)&priv->dma_desc[0]);
1236	#endif
1237	
1238	  /* Reset data */
1239	
1240	  priv->waitevents = 0;      /* Set of events to be waited for */
1241	  priv->waitmask   = 0;      /* Interrupt enables for event waiting */
1242	  priv->wkupevent  = 0;      /* The event that caused the wakeup */
1243	
1244	  wd_cancel(&priv->waitwdog); /* Cancel any timeouts */
1245	
1246	  /* Interrupt mode data transfer support */
1247	
1248	  priv->buffer     = 0;      /* Address of current R/W buffer */
1249	  priv->remaining  = 0;      /* Number of bytes remaining in the transfer */
1250	  priv->xfrmask    = 0;      /* Interrupt enables for data transfer */
1251	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
1252	  priv->dmamask    = 0;      /* Interrupt enables for DMA transfer */
1253	#endif
1254	
1255	  /* DMA data transfer support */
1256	
1257	  priv->cdstatus   = 0;      /* Card status is unknown */
1258	
1259	  leave_critical_section(flags);
1260	}

1362	/****************************************************************************
1363	 * Name: sdmmc_host_clock_update_command
1364	 *
1365	 * Description:
1366	 *   Send a clock update command to CIU. This is not a real command;
1367	 *   it just updates CIU registers (CLKDIV, CLKSRC, CLKENA).
1368	 *
1369	 * Input Parameters:
1370	 *   priv - A reference to the SD card device state structure
1371	 *
1372	 * Returned Value:
1373	 *   OK on success; a negated errno on failure
1374	 *
1375	 ****************************************************************************/
1376	
1377	static int sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv)
1378	{
1379	  sdmmc_hw_cmd_t cmd_val;
1380	  clock_t watchtime;
1381	
1382	  memset(&cmd_val, 0, sizeof(cmd_val));
1383	  cmd_val.update_clk_reg = 1;
1384	  cmd_val.wait_complete = 1;
1385	  cmd_val.card_num = priv->slot;
1386	  cmd_val.use_hold_reg = 1;
1387	  cmd_val.start_command = 1;
1388	
1389	  /* Wait for previous command to be taken */
1390	
1391	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
1392	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_command_taken(&SDMMC))
1393	    {
1394	      if (clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
1395	        {
1396	          mcerr("TMO waiting for command taken\n");
1397	          return -ETIMEDOUT;
1398	        }
1399	    }
1400	
1401	  sdmmc_ll_set_command_arg(&SDMMC, 0);
1402	  sdmmc_ll_set_command(&SDMMC, cmd_val);
1403	
1404	  /* Wait for command to complete */
1405	
1406	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
1407	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_command_taken(&SDMMC))
1408	    {
1409	      if (clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
1410	        {
1411	          mcerr("TMO waiting for clock update complete\n");
1412	          return -ETIMEDOUT;
1413	        }
1414	    }
1415	
1416	  return OK;
1417	}

1419	/****************************************************************************
1420	 * Name: sdmmc_host_get_clk_dividers
1421	 *
1422	 * Description:
1423	 *   Calculate clock dividers for the requested frequency.
1424	 *
1425	 *   We have two clock divider stages:
1426	 *   - Host divider: divides the source clock (160MHz PLL160M)
1427	 *   - Card divider: divides the host clock by 2*n
1428	 *
1429	 * Input Parameters:
1430	 *   freq_khz - Requested frequency in kHz
1431	 *   host_div - Output: host clock divider
1432	 *   card_div - Output: card clock divider
1433	 *
1434	 * Returned Value:
1435	 *   None
1436	 *
1437	 ****************************************************************************/
1438	
1439	static void sdmmc_host_get_clk_dividers(uint32_t freq_khz, int *host_div,
1440	                                        int *card_div)
1441	{
1442	  /* For ESP32P4, we use PLL160M (160MHz) as the source clock.
1443	   *
1444	   * The host divider can be 1-16 (configured in HP_SYS_CLKRST registers).
1445	   * The card divider can be 0 (bypass) or 1-255 (actual div = 2*card_div).
1446	   *
1447	   * actual_freq = clk_src / host_div                   when card_div == 0
1448	   * actual_freq = clk_src / host_div / (2 * card_div)  when card_div > 0
1449	   */
1450	
1451	  uint32_t clk_src_freq_khz = BOARD_SDMMC_FREQUENCY / 1000;
1452	
1453	  if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz)
1454	    {
1455	      /* Maximum frequency: source clock / 1 */
1456	
1457	      *host_div = 1;
1458	      *card_div = 0;
1459	    }
1460	  else if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz / 2)
1461	    {
1462	      *host_div = 2;
1463	      *card_div = 0;
1464	    }
1465	  else if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz / 4)
1466	    {
1467	      *host_div = 4;
1468	      *card_div = 0;
1469	    }
1470	  else if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz / 8)
1471	    {
1472	      *host_div = 8;
1473	      *card_div = 0;
1474	    }
1475	  else if (freq_khz >= clk_src_freq_khz / 16)
1476	    {
1477	      *host_div = 16;
1478	      *card_div = 0;
1479	    }
1480	  else
1481	    {
1482	      /* Need two-stage division */
1483	
1484	      uint32_t target_hz = freq_khz * 1000;
1485	      uint32_t total_div = (BOARD_SDMMC_FREQUENCY + target_hz - 1) / target_hz;
1486	
1487	      if (total_div <= 16)
1488	        {
1489	          *host_div = (int)total_div;
1490	          *card_div = 0;
1491	        }
1492	      else
1493	        {
1494	          /* Two-stage: find best combination */
1495	
1496	          *host_div = 2;
1497	          *card_div = 255;
1498	          for (int h = 2; h <= 16; h++)
1499	            {
1500	              uint32_t intermediate = BOARD_SDMMC_FREQUENCY / h;
1501	              int c = (int)((intermediate + 2 * target_hz - 1) /
1502	                       (2 * target_hz));
1503	              if (c < 1)
1504	                {
1505	                  c = 1;
1506	                }
1507	              if (c <= 255)
1508	                {
1509	                  *host_div = h;
1510	                  *card_div = c;
1511	                  break;
1512	                }
1513	            }
1514	        }
1515	    }
1516	
1517	  mcinfo("freq_khz=%" PRIu32 " host_div=%d card_div=%d\n",
1518	         freq_khz, *host_div, *card_div);
1519	}
1520	
1521	/****************************************************************************
1522	 * Name: sdmmc_host_set_clk_div
1523	 *
1524	 * Description:
1525	 *   Set the clock dividers in the hardware.
1526	 *
1527	 * Input Parameters:
1528	 *   slot     - Slot number
1529	 *   host_div - Host clock divider
1530	 *   card_div - Card clock divider
1531	 *
1532	 * Returned Value:
1533	 *   None
1534	 *
1535	 ****************************************************************************/
1536	
1537	static void sdmmc_host_set_clk_div(uint32_t slot, uint32_t host_div,
1538	                                   uint32_t card_div)
1539	{
1540	  /* Disable card clock first */
1541	
1542	  sdmmc_ll_enable_card_clock(&SDMMC, slot, false);
1543	  sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(&g_sdiodev);
1544	
1545	  /* Set host clock divider and clock source (requires RCC atomic) */
1546	
1547	  SDMMC_RCC_ATOMIC()
1548	    {
1549	      sdmmc_ll_set_clock_div(&SDMMC, host_div);
1550	      sdmmc_ll_select_clk_source(&SDMMC, SDMMC_CLK_SRC_PLL160M);
1551	      sdmmc_ll_init_phase_delay(&SDMMC);
1552	    }
1553	
1554	  /* Set card clock divider */
1555	
1556	  sdmmc_ll_set_card_clock_div(&SDMMC, slot, card_div);
1557	
1558	  /* Send clock update command */
1559	
1560	  sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(&g_sdiodev);
1561	
1562	  /* Re-enable card clock */
1563	
1564	  sdmmc_ll_enable_card_clock(&SDMMC, slot, true);
1565	  sdmmc_ll_enable_card_clock_low_power(&SDMMC, slot, true);
1566	  sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(&g_sdiodev);
1567	
1568	  /* Set timeouts */
1569	
1570	  uint32_t freq_khz = BOARD_SDMMC_FREQUENCY / host_div /
1571	                       ((card_div == 0) ? 1 : card_div * 2) / 1000;
1572	  uint32_t data_timeout_ms = 100;
1573	  uint32_t data_timeout_cycles = data_timeout_ms * freq_khz;
1574	  sdmmc_ll_set_data_timeout(&SDMMC, data_timeout_cycles);
1575	  sdmmc_ll_set_response_timeout(&SDMMC, 255);
1576	
1577	  mcinfo("slot=%" PRIu32 " host_div=%" PRIu32 " card_div=%" PRIu32 "\n",
1578	         slot, host_div, card_div);
1579	}

1581	/****************************************************************************
1582	 * Name: esp32p4_clock
1583	 *
1584	 * Description:
1585	 *   Enable/disable SDIO clocking
1586	 *
1587	 * Input Parameters:
1588	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1589	 *   rate - Specifies the clocking to use (see enum sdio_clock_e)
1590	 *
1591	 * Returned Value:
1592	 *   None
1593	 *
1594	 ****************************************************************************/
1595	
1596	static void esp32p4_clock(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, enum sdio_clock_e rate)
1597	{
1598	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
1599	  uint32_t freq_khz;
1600	  int host_div;
1601	  int card_div;
1602	
1603	  mcinfo("rate=%d\n", rate);
1604	
1605	  switch (rate)
1606	    {
1607	      case CLOCK_SDIO_DISABLED:
1608	        sdmmc_ll_enable_card_clock(&SDMMC, priv->slot, false);
1609	        sdmmc_host_clock_update_command(priv);
1610	        return;
1611	
1612	      case CLOCK_IDMODE:
1613	        /* Initial ID mode clocking (<400KHz) */
1614	
1615	        freq_khz = 400;
1616	        break;
1617	
1618	      case CLOCK_MMC_TRANSFER:
1619	        /* MMC normal operation clocking (up to 52MHz) */
1620	
1621	        freq_khz = 52000;
1622	        break;
1623	
1624	      case CLOCK_SD_TRANSFER_1BIT:
1625	      case CLOCK_SD_TRANSFER_4BIT:
1626	        /* SD normal operation clocking (up to 50MHz) */
1627	
1628	        freq_khz = 50000;
1629	        break;
1630	
1631	      default:
1632	        mcerr("ERROR: Unknown rate: %d\n", rate);
1633	        return;
1634	    }
1635	
1636	  /* Calculate and set clock dividers */
1637	
1638	  sdmmc_host_get_clk_dividers(freq_khz, &host_div, &card_div);
1639	  sdmmc_host_set_clk_div(priv->slot, host_div, card_div);
1640	}

1845	 * Name: esp32p4_cancel

1849	 *   SDIO_DMARECVSETUP or SDIO_DMASENDSETUP.  This must be called to cancel
1850	 *   the data transfer setup if, for some reason, you cannot perform the
1851	 *   transfer.
1852	 *
1853	 * Input Parameters:
1854	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1855	 *
1856	 * Returned Value:
1857	 *   OK is success; a negated errno on failure
1858	 *
1859	 ****************************************************************************/
1860	
1861	static int esp32p4_cancel(struct sdio_dev_s *dev)
1862	{
1863	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
1864	
1865	  mcinfo("Cancelling transfer\n");
1866	
1867	  /* Disable all transfer-related interrupts */
1868	
1869	  esp32p4_disable_allints(priv);
1870	
1871	  /* Reset the data state machine */
1872	
1873	  SDMMC.ctrl.abort_read_data = 1;
1874	
1875	  /* Wait for the abort to complete */
1876	
1877	  clock_t watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
1878	  while (SDMMC.ctrl.abort_read_data)
1879	    {
1880	      if (clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
1881	        {
1882	          mcerr("TMO waiting for abort\n");
1883	          break;
1884	        }
1885	    }
1886	
1887	  /* Reset the FIFO */
1888	
1889	  sdmmc_ll_reset_fifo(&SDMMC);
1890	  while (!sdmmc_ll_is_fifo_reset_done(&SDMMC))
1891	    {
1892	    }
1893	
1894	  /* Clear any pending interrupts */
1895	
1896	  sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, 0xffffffff);
1897	
1898	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_DMA
1899	  /* Stop DMA */
1900	
1901	  sdmmc_ll_stop_dma(&SDMMC);
1902	  sdmmc_ll_clear_idsts_interrupt(&SDMMC, 0xffffffff);
1903	#endif
1904	
1905	  priv->remaining = 0;
1906	  priv->buffer    = NULL;
1907	
1908	  return OK;
1909	}

1911	/****************************************************************************
1912	 * Name: esp32p4_waitresponse
1913	 *
1914	 * Description:
1915	 *   Poll-wait for the response to the last command to be ready.  This
1916	 *   function should be called even after sending commands that have no
1917	 *   response (such as CMD0) to make sure that the hardware is ready to
1918	 *   receive the next command.
1919	 *
1920	 * Input Parameters:
1921	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
1922	 *   cmd  - The command that was sent. See 32-bit command definitions above.
1923	 *
1924	 * Returned Value:
1925	 *   OK is success; a negated errno on failure
1926	 *
1927	 ****************************************************************************/
1928	
1929	static int esp32p4_waitresponse(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd)
1930	{
1931	  clock_t watchtime;
1932	  uint32_t status;
1933	
1934	  mcinfo("cmd: %08" PRIx32 "\n", cmd);
1935	
1936	  /* Wait for command completion or response.
1937	   *
1938	   * Poll-wait for the command to complete.  This is not the normal path
1939	   * for SDIO operations; normally, the interrupt handler will detect
1940	   * command completion.
1941	   */
1942	
1943	  watchtime = clock_systime_ticks();
1944	
1945	  for (; ; )
1946	    {
1947	      /* Check for command done */
1948	
1949	      status = sdmmc_ll_get_interrupt_raw(&SDMMC);
1950	
1951	      if ((status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE) != 0)
1952	        {
1953	          /* Clear the command done interrupt */
1954	
1955	          sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE);
1956	          break;
1957	        }
1958	
1959	      /* Check for response timeout */
1960	
1961	      if ((status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RTO) != 0)
1962	        {
1963	          /* Clear the timeout interrupt */
1964	
1965	          sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RTO);
1966	          mcerr("ERROR: Response timeout\n");
1967	          return -ETIMEDOUT;
1968	        }
1969	
1970	      /* Check for response CRC error */
1971	
1972	      if ((status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RCRC) != 0)
1973	        {
1974	          /* Clear the CRC error interrupt */
1975	
1976	          sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RCRC);
1977	          mcerr("ERROR: Response CRC error\n");
1978	          return -EIO;
1979	        }
1980	
1981	      /* Check for response error */
1982	
1983	      if ((status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RESP_ERR) != 0)
1984	        {
1985	          /* Clear the response error interrupt */
1986	
1987	          sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RESP_ERR);
1988	          mcerr("ERROR: Response error\n");
1989	          return -EIO;
1990	        }
1991	
1992	      /* Check for timeout */
1993	
1994	      if ((clock_systime_ticks() - watchtime) > SDCARD_CMDTIMEOUT)
1995	        {
1996	          mcerr("TMO waiting for response\n");
1997	          return -ETIMEDOUT;
1998	        }
1999	    }
2000	
2001	  return OK;
2002	}

2037	/****************************************************************************
2038	 * Name: esp32p4_recvlong
2039	 *
2040	 * Description:
2041	 *   Receive response to SDIO command.  Only the critical payload is
2042	 *   returned -- 128 bits for 136 bit status.  The driver implementation
2043	 *   verifies the correctness of the remaining, non-returned bits (CRCs, CMD
2044	 *   index, etc.).
2045	 *
2046	 * Input Parameters:
2047	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
2048	 *   cmd  - The command that was sent
2049	 *   rlong - Buffer in which to receive the response (4 x 32-bit)
2050	 *
2051	 * Returned Value:
2052	 *   OK on success; a negated errno on failure.
2053	 *
2054	 ****************************************************************************/
2055	
2056	static int esp32p4_recvlong(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd,
2057	                            uint32_t rlong[4])
2058	{
2059	  mcinfo("cmd: %08" PRIx32 "\n", cmd);
2060	
2061	  /* Read the long response from the response registers.
2062	   * The SDMMC controller stores the response in reverse order:
2063	   * resp[0] = bits [127:96]
2064	   * resp[1] = bits [95:64]
2065	   * resp[2] = bits [63:32]
2066	   * resp[3] = bits [31:0]
2067	   *
2068	   * NuttX expects:
2069	   * rlong[0] = bits [127:96]
2070	   * rlong[1] = bits [95:64]
2071	   * rlong[2] = bits [63:32]
2072	   * rlong[3] = bits [31:0]
2073	   */
2074	
2075	  rlong[0] = SDMMC.resp[3];
2076	  rlong[1] = SDMMC.resp[2];
2077	  rlong[2] = SDMMC.resp[1];
2078	  rlong[3] = SDMMC.resp[0];
2079	
2080	  mcinfo("response: %08" PRIx32 " %08" PRIx32 " %08" PRIx32 " %08" PRIx32
2081	         "\n", rlong[0], rlong[1], rlong[2], rlong[3]);
2082	
2083	  return OK;
2084	}

2119	/****************************************************************************
2120	 * Name: esp32p4_waitenable
2121	 *
2122	 * Description:
2123	 *   Enable/disable of a set of SDIO wait events.  This is part of the
2124	 *   the SDIO_WAITEVENT sequence.  The set of to-be-waited-for events is
2125	 *   configured before calling esp32p4_eventwait.  This is done in this way
2126	 *   to help the driver to eliminate race conditions between the command
2127	 *   setup and the subsequent events.
2128	 *
2129	 *   The enabled events persist until either (1) SDIO_WAITENABLE is called
2130	 *   again specifying a different set of wait events, or (2) SDIO_EVENTWAIT
2131	 *   returns.
2132	 *
2133	 * Input Parameters:
2134	 *   dev      - An instance of the SDIO device interface
2135	 *   eventset - A bitset of events to enable or disable (see SDIOWAIT_*
2136	 *              definitions). 0=disable; 1=enable.
2137	 *   timeout  - Maximum time in milliseconds to wait
2138	 *
2139	 * Returned Value:
2140	 *   None
2141	 *
2142	 ****************************************************************************/
2143	
2144	static void esp32p4_waitenable(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, sdio_eventset_t eventset,
2145	                               uint32_t timeout)
2146	{
2147	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
2148	  uint32_t waitmask = 0;
2149	
2150	  mcinfo("eventset: %02x timeout: %" PRIu32 "\n", eventset, timeout);
2151	
2152	  /* Disable previous wait interrupts */
2153	
2154	  esp32p4_config_waitints(priv, 0, 0, 0);
2155	
2156	  /* Clear any pending interrupts */
2157	
2158	  sdmmc_ll_clear_interrupt(&SDMMC, 0xffffffff);
2159	
2160	  /* Enable interrupts based on the requested events */
2161	
2162	  if ((eventset & SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE) != 0)
2163	    {
2164	      waitmask |= SDCARD_CMDDONE_MASK;
2165	    }
2166	
2167	  if ((eventset & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) != 0)
2168	    {
2169	      waitmask |= SDCARD_RESPDONE_MASK;
2170	    }
2171	
2172	  if ((eventset & SDIOWAIT_TIMEOUT) != 0)
2173	    {
2174	      /* Start the watchdog timer */
2175	
2176	      wd_start(&priv->waitwdog, MSEC2TICK(timeout),
2177	               esp32p4_eventtimeout, (wdparm_t)priv);
2178	    }
2179	
2180	  /* Enable the wait interrupts */
2181	
2182	  esp32p4_config_waitints(priv, waitmask, eventset, 0);
2183	}

2185	/****************************************************************************
2186	 * Name: esp32p4_eventwait
2187	 *
2188	 * Description:
2189	 *   Wait for one of the enabled events to occur (or a timeout).  Note that
2190	 *   all events enabled by SDIO_WAITEVENTS are disabled when
2191	 *   esp32p4_eventwait returns.  SDIO_WAITEVENTS must be called again before
2192	 *   esp32p4_eventwait can be used again.
2193	 *
2194	 * Input Parameters:
2195	 *   dev - An instance of the SDIO device interface
2196	 *
2197	 * Returned Value:
2198	 *   Event set containing the event(s) that ended the wait.  Should always
2199	 *   be non-zero.  All events are disabled after the wait concludes.
2200	 *
2201	 ****************************************************************************/
2202	
2203	static sdio_eventset_t esp32p4_eventwait(struct sdio_dev_s *dev)
2204	{
2205	  struct esp32p4_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_dev_s *)dev;
2206	  sdio_eventset_t wkupevent;
2207	  irqstate_t flags;
2208	  int ret;
2209	
2210	  mcinfo("Waiting for events\n");
2211	
2212	  /* Wait for the posted semaphore event */
2213	
2214	  ret = nxsem_wait(&priv->waitsem);
2215	  if (ret < 0)
2216	    {
2217	      mcerr("ERROR: nxsem_wait failed: %d\n", ret);
2218	      return SDIOWAIT_ERROR;
2219	    }
2220	
2221	  /* Return the event that caused the wakeup */
2222	
2223	  flags = enter_critical_section();
2224	  wkupevent = priv->wkupevent;
2225	  priv->wkupevent = 0;
2226	  leave_critical_section(flags);
2227	
2228	  mcinfo("wkupevent=%02x\n", wkupevent);
2229	
2230	  return wkupevent;
2231	}

  if(NXTMPDIR)
    set(ESP_HAL_NXTMPDIR_CACHE "${NXTMPDIR_PATH}/${ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REPO_NAME}")
    get_filename_component(ESP_HAL_NXTMPDIR_CACHE "${ESP_HAL_NXTMPDIR_CACHE}"
                           REALPATH)
    nuttx_check_git_hash(
      "${ESP_HAL_NXTMPDIR_CACHE}" "${ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION}"
      ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REVISION_OK)
    if(NOT ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_REVISION_OK)
      if(EXISTS "${ESP_HAL_NXTMPDIR_CACHE}")
        message(

      esp_hal_3rdparty

      GIT_TAG ${ESP_HAL_3RDPARTY_VERSION}

269	/****************************************************************************
270	 * Name: esp_sdmmc_configure_pins
271	 *
272	 * Description:
273	 *   Configure GPIO pins for SDMMC slot 1 (GPIO matrix mode).
274	 *   Slot 0 uses IOMUX and does not need GPIO matrix configuration.
275	 *
276	 ****************************************************************************/
277	
278	static void esp_sdmmc_configure_pins(struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *priv) {
279	  if (priv->slot == 0) {
280	    /* Slot 0 uses IOMUX - no GPIO matrix configuration needed.
281	     * The pins are fixed and configured by the hardware.
282	     */
283	
284	    return;
285	  }
286	
287	  /* Slot 1: Configure GPIO matrix pins.
288	   *
289	   * CLK - output only (push-pull)
290	   * CMD - bidirectional (open-drain with pull-up)
291	   * D0-D3 - bidirectional (open-drain with pull-up)
292	   *
293	   * GPIO signal indices from gpio_sig_map.h:
294	   *   SD_CARD_CCLK_2_PAD_OUT_IDX  = 0  (CLK output)
295	   *   SD_CARD_CCMD_2_PAD_IN_IDX   = 1  (CMD input)
296	   *   SD_CARD_CCMD_2_PAD_OUT_IDX  = 1  (CMD output)
297	   *   SD_CARD_CDATA0_2_PAD_IN_IDX = 2  (D0 input)
298	   *   SD_CARD_CDATA0_2_PAD_OUT_IDX= 2  (D0 output)
299	   *   ... etc.
300	   */
301	
302	  /* CLK - output only */
303	
304	  esp_configgpio(priv->pin_clk, OUTPUT | FUNCTION);
305	  esp_gpio_matrix_out(priv->pin_clk, SD_CARD_CCLK_2_PAD_OUT_IDX, false, false);
306	
307	  /* CMD - bidirectional (open-drain with pull-up) */
308	
309	  esp_configgpio(priv->pin_cmd, INPUT | OUTPUT | OPEN_DRAIN | PULLUP);
310	  esp_gpio_matrix_out(priv->pin_cmd, SD_CARD_CCMD_2_PAD_OUT_IDX, false, false);
311	  esp_gpio_matrix_in(priv->pin_cmd, SD_CARD_CCMD_2_PAD_IN_IDX, false);
312	
313	  /* D0 - bidirectional */
314	
315	  esp_configgpio(priv->pin_d0, INPUT | OUTPUT | OPEN_DRAIN | PULLUP);
316	  esp_gpio_matrix_out(priv->pin_d0, SD_CARD_CDATA0_2_PAD_OUT_IDX, false, false);
317	  esp_gpio_matrix_in(priv->pin_d0, SD_CARD_CDATA0_2_PAD_IN_IDX, false);
318	
319	  /* D1 - bidirectional */
320	
321	  esp_configgpio(priv->pin_d1, INPUT | OUTPUT | OPEN_DRAIN | PULLUP);
322	  esp_gpio_matrix_out(priv->pin_d1, SD_CARD_CDATA1_2_PAD_OUT_IDX, false, false);
323	  esp_gpio_matrix_in(priv->pin_d1, SD_CARD_CDATA1_2_PAD_IN_IDX, false);
324	
325	  /* D2 - bidirectional */
326	
327	  esp_configgpio(priv->pin_d2, INPUT | OUTPUT | OPEN_DRAIN | PULLUP);
328	  esp_gpio_matrix_out(priv->pin_d2, SD_CARD_CDATA2_2_PAD_OUT_IDX, false, false);
329	  esp_gpio_matrix_in(priv->pin_d2, SD_CARD_CDATA2_2_PAD_IN_IDX, false);
330	
331	  /* D3 - bidirectional */
332	
333	  esp_configgpio(priv->pin_d3, INPUT | OUTPUT | OPEN_DRAIN | PULLUP);
334	  esp_gpio_matrix_out(priv->pin_d3, SD_CARD_CDATA3_2_PAD_OUT_IDX, false, false);
335	  esp_gpio_matrix_in(priv->pin_d3, SD_CARD_CDATA3_2_PAD_IN_IDX, false);
336	}

338	/****************************************************************************
339	 * Name: esp_sdmmc_set_frequency
340	 *
341	 * Description:
342	 *   Set the SDMMC clock frequency using the HAL layer.
343	 *
344	 ****************************************************************************/
345	
346	static int esp_sdmmc_set_frequency(struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *priv,
347	                                   uint32_t freq) {
348	  sdmmc_dev_t *hw = SDMMC_HW;
349	
350	  if (freq == 0) {
351	    return -EINVAL;
352	  }
353	
354	  /* Select clock source */
355	
356	  sdmmc_ll_select_clk_source(hw, SDMMC_LL_CLK_SRC_DEFAULT);
357	
358	  /* Calculate divider: source_freq / target_freq */
359	
360	  uint32_t divider = (SDMMC_CLK_SRC_FREQ + freq - 1) / freq;
361	  if (divider < 1) {
362	    divider = 1;
363	  }
364	
365	  /* Set card clock divider and enable */
366	
367	  sdmmc_ll_set_card_clock_div(hw, priv->slot, divider);
368	  sdmmc_ll_enable_card_clock(hw, priv->slot, true);
369	
370	  priv->frequency = freq;
371	  return OK;
372	}

374	/****************************************************************************
375	 * Name: esp_sdmmc_wait_cmd_done
376	 *
377	 * Description:
378	 *   Wait for command done interrupt with timeout.
379	 *
380	 ****************************************************************************/
381	
382	static int esp_sdmmc_wait_cmd_done(struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *priv,
383	                                   uint32_t timeout_ms) {
384	  uint32_t start = clock_systime_ticks();
385	  uint32_t ticks = MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
386	  sdmmc_dev_t *hw = SDMMC_HW;
387	
388	  while ((clock_systime_ticks() - start) < ticks) {
389	    uint32_t rintsts = hw->rintsts.val;
390	    if (rintsts & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE) {
391	      /* Clear the interrupt */
392	
393	      hw->rintsts.val = SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE;
394	      return OK;
395	    }
396	
397	    up_udelay(10);
398	  }
399	
400	  snerr("ERROR: CMD done timeout\n");
401	  return -ETIMEDOUT;
402	}

412	static int esp_sdmmc_wait_data_done(struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *priv,
413	                                    uint32_t timeout_ms) {

415	  uint32_t ticks = MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);

424	      return OK;
425	    }
426	
427	    up_udelay(10);
428	  }
429	
430	  snerr("ERROR: Data done timeout\n");
431	  return -ETIMEDOUT;
432	}

455	/****************************************************************************
456	 * Name: esp_sdmmc_setup_dma_transfer
457	 *
458	 * Description:
459	 *   Set up DMA descriptors for a data transfer using the internal DMA
460	 *   controller (IDMAC).
461	 *
462	 ****************************************************************************/
463	
464	static void esp_sdmmc_setup_dma_transfer(struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *priv,
465	                                         uint8_t *buffer, size_t len,
466	                                         bool is_tx) {
467	  sdmmc_desc_t *desc = priv->dma_desc;
468	  sdmmc_dev_t *hw = SDMMC_HW;
469	
470	  /* Configure DMA descriptor using the HAL structure */
471	
472	  memset(desc, 0, sizeof(*desc));
473	
474	  desc->owned_by_idmac = 1;   /* Owned by IDMAC */
475	  desc->first_descriptor = 1; /* First descriptor */
476	  desc->last_descriptor = 1;  /* Last descriptor */
477	  desc->disable_int_on_completion = 0;
478	
479	  if (is_tx) {
480	    desc->second_address_chained = 0; /* Not chained */
481	  } else {
482	    desc->second_address_chained = 0; /* Not chained */
483	  }
484	
485	  desc->buffer1_size = len & 0x1fffu; /* Buffer 1 size (13 bits) */
486	  desc->buffer2_size = 0;             /* No second buffer */
487	  desc->buffer1_ptr = buffer;
488	  desc->buffer2_ptr = NULL; /* No second buffer */
489	
490	  /* Set data transfer length */
491	
492	  hw->bytcnt.byte_count = len;
493	  hw->blksiz.block_size = SDMMC_DMA_MAX_BUF_LEN;
494	
495	  /* Point DMA to descriptor */
496	
497	  hw->dbaddr.val = (uint32_t)desc;
498	
499	  /* Start DMA by writing to PLDMND */
500	
501	  hw->pldmnd.val = 1;
502	}

504	/****************************************************************************
505	 * Name: esp_sdmmc_interrupt
506	 *
507	 * Description:
508	 *   SDMMC interrupt handler.
509	 *
510	 ****************************************************************************/
511	
512	static int esp_sdmmc_interrupt(int irq, void *context, void *arg) {
513	  struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *)arg;
514	  sdmmc_dev_t *hw = SDMMC_HW;
515	  uint32_t status = hw->rintsts.val;
516	  irqstate_t flags;
517	  bool post = false;
518	
519	  flags = spin_lock_irqsave(&priv->lock);
520	
521	  /* Check for command done */
522	
523	  if (status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE) {
524	    hw->rintsts.val = SDMMC_LL_EVENT_CMD_DONE;
525	    priv->events |= SDMMC_EVENT_CMDDONE;
526	
527	    if (priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_CMDDONE) {
528	      post = true;
529	    }
530	  }
531	
532	  /* Check for data over (transfer complete) */
533	
534	  if (status & SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DATA_OVER) {
535	    hw->rintsts.val = SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DATA_OVER;
536	    priv->events |= SDMMC_EVENT_DATADONE;
537	
538	    if (priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_RESPONSEDONE) {
539	      post = true;
540	    }
541	  }
542	
543	  /* Check for errors */
544	
545	  if (status & (SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RCRC | SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DCRC | SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RTO |
546	                SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DTO | SDMMC_LL_EVENT_SBE | SDMMC_LL_EVENT_EBE)) {
547	    hw->rintsts.val = status & (SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RCRC | SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DCRC |
548	                                SDMMC_LL_EVENT_RTO | SDMMC_LL_EVENT_DTO |
549	                                SDMMC_LL_EVENT_SBE | SDMMC_LL_EVENT_EBE);
550	
551	    priv->events |= SDMMC_EVENT_ERROR;
552	
553	    if (priv->waitevents & SDIOWAIT_ERROR) {
554	      post = true;
555	    }
556	  }
557	
558	  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&priv->lock, flags);
559	
560	  /* Post semaphore if we have a matching event */
561	
562	  if (post) {
563	    nxsem_post(&priv->waitsem);
564	  }
565	
566	  /* Call registered callback if enabled */
567	
568	  if (priv->callback && (priv->events & priv->cbevents)) {
569	    priv->callback(&priv->dev, priv->cbarg);
570	  }
571	
572	  return OK;
573	}

687	/****************************************************************************
688	 * Name: esp_sdmmc_clock
689	 *
690	 * Description:
691	 *   Set the SDIO clock frequency.
692	 *
693	 ****************************************************************************/
694	
695	static void esp_sdmmc_clock(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, enum sdio_clock_e rate) {
696	  struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *)dev;
697	
698	  uint32_t freq_khz;
699	  bool clk_en = true;
700	  switch (rate) {
701	    /* Disable clocking (with default ID mode divisor) */
702	
703	  default:
704	  case CLOCK_SDIO_DISABLED:
705	    freq_khz = 400;
706	    clk_en = false;
707	    break;
708	
709	    /* Enable in initial ID mode clocking (<400KHz) */
710	
711	  case CLOCK_IDMODE:
712	    freq_khz = 400;
713	    break;
714	
715	    /* Enable in MMC normal operation clocking */
716	
717	  case CLOCK_MMC_TRANSFER:
718	    if (esp_sdmmc_capabilities(dev) & SDIO_CAPS_MMC_HS_MODE) {
719	      freq_khz = 40 * 1000;
720	    } else {
721	      freq_khz = 20 * 1000;
722	    }
723	    break;
724	
725	    /* SD normal operation clocking (wide 4-bit mode) */
726	
727	  case CLOCK_SD_TRANSFER_4BIT:
728	    /* TODO: Use higher frequency */
729	
730	    freq_khz = 20 * 1000;
731	    esp_sdmmc_widebus(dev, true);
732	    break;
733	
734	    /* SD normal operation clocking (narrow 1-bit mode) */
735	
736	  case CLOCK_SD_TRANSFER_1BIT:
737	
738	    /* TODO: Use higher frequency */

798	/****************************************************************************
799	 * Name: esp_sdmmc_sendcmd
800	 *
801	 * Description:
802	 *   Send an SDMMC command.
803	 *
804	 ****************************************************************************/
805	
806	static int esp_sdmmc_sendcmd(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd,
807	                             uint32_t arg) {
808	  struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *priv = (struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *)dev;
809	  sdmmc_dev_t *hw = SDMMC_HW;
810	  uint32_t cmdreg = 0;
811	  int ret;
812	
813	  /* Build the command register value */
814	
815	  /* Command index (bits 5:0) */
816	
817	  cmdreg |= (MMCSD_CMDINDEX(cmd) & 0x3fu) << SDHOST_CMD_INDEX_S;
818	
819	  /* Response type */
820	
821	  if (MMCSD_CMDRESP(cmd) == MMCSD_R1 || MMCSD_CMDRESP(cmd) == MMCSD_R5 ||
822	      MMCSD_CMDRESP(cmd) == MMCSD_R6 || MMCSD_CMDRESP(cmd) == MMCSD_R7) {
823	    cmdreg |= SDHOST_RESPONSE_EXPECT;    /* Expect short response */
824	    cmdreg |= SDHOST_CHECK_RESPONSE_CRC; /* Check response CRC */
825	  } else if (MMCSD_CMDRESP(cmd) == MMCSD_R2) {
826	    cmdreg |= SDHOST_RESPONSE_EXPECT;    /* Expect response (136-bit) */
827	    cmdreg |= SDHOST_RESPONSE_LENGTH;    /* Long response */
828	    cmdreg |= SDHOST_CHECK_RESPONSE_CRC; /* Check response CRC */
829	  } else if (MMCSD_CMDRESP(cmd) == MMCSD_R3 || MMCSD_CMDRESP(cmd) == MMCSD_R4) {
830	    cmdreg |= SDHOST_RESPONSE_EXPECT; /* Expect response, no CRC */
831	  }
832	
833	  /* Data transfer */
834	
835	  if (MMCSD_CMDDATA(cmd)) {
836	    cmdreg |= SDHOST_DATA_EXPECTED; /* Data expected */
837	
838	    if (MMCSD_CMDWRITE(cmd)) {
839	      cmdreg |= SDHOST_READ_WRITE; /* Write operation */
840	    }
841	  }
842	
843	  /* Wait for previous data transfer to complete */
844	
845	  cmdreg |= SDHOST_WAIT_PRVDATA_COMPLETE;
846	
847	  /* Set card number */
848	
849	  cmdreg |= (priv->slot & 0x1fu) << SDHOST_CARD_NUMBER_S;
850	
851	  /* Clear pending events */
852	
853	  priv->events = 0;
854	
855	  /* Send the command */
856	
857	  esp_sdmmc_start_command(priv, cmdreg, arg);
858	
859	  /* Wait for command done (with timeout) */
860	
861	  ret = esp_sdmmc_wait_cmd_done(priv, 1000);
862	  if (ret < 0) {
863	    snerr("ERROR: Command %d failed: %d\n", MMCSD_CMDINDEX(cmd), ret);
864	    return ret;
865	  }
866	
867	  return OK;
868	}

971	/****************************************************************************
972	 * Name: esp_sdmmc_recvshortcrc
973	 *
974	 * Description:
975	 *   Receive response to SDIO command.  Only the critical payload is
976	 *   returned -- 32 bits for 48 bit status.  The driver implementation
977	 *   verifies the correctness of the remaining, non-returned bits (CRCs, CMD
978	 *   index, etc.).
979	 *
980	 * Input Parameters:
981	 *   dev  - An instance of the SDIO device interface
982	 *   Rx   - Buffer in which to receive the response
983	 *
984	 * Returned Value:
985	 *   Number of bytes sent on success; a negated errno on failure.  Here a
986	 *   failure means only a faiure to obtain the requested response (due to
987	 *   transport problem -- timeout, CRC, etc.).  The implementation only
988	 *   assures that the response is returned intacta and does not check errors
989	 *   within the response itself.
990	 *
991	 ****************************************************************************/
992	
993	static int esp_sdmmc_recvshortcrc(struct sdio_dev_s *dev, uint32_t cmd,
994	                                  uint32_t *rshort) {
995	  uint32_t regval;
996	  int ret = OK;
997	
998	  mcinfo("cmd=%04x\n", cmd);
999	  /* R1  Command response (48-bit)
1000	   *     47        0               Start bit
1001	   *     46        0               Transmission bit (0=from card)
1002	   *     45:40     bit5   - bit0   Command index (0-63)
1003	   *     39:8      bit31  - bit0   32-bit card status
1004	   *     7:1       bit6   - bit0   CRC7
1005	   *     0         1               End bit
1006	   *
1007	   * R1b Identical to R1 with the additional busy signaling via the data
1008	   *     line.
1009	   *
1010	   * R6  Published RCA Response (48-bit, SD card only)
1011	   *     47        0               Start bit
1012	   *     46        0               Transmission bit (0=from card)
1013	   *     45:40     bit5   - bit0   Command index (0-63)
1014	   *     39:8      bit31  - bit0   32-bit Argument Field, consisting of:
1015	   *                               [31:16] New published RCA of card
1016	   *                               [15:0]  Card status bits {23,22,19,12:0}
1017	   *     7:1       bit6   - bit0   CRC7
1018	   *     0         1               End bit
1019	   */
1020	
1021	#ifdef CONFIG_DEBUG_FEATURES
1022	  if (!rshort) {
1023	    mcerr("ERROR: rshort=NULL\n");
1024	    ret = -EINVAL;
1025	  }
1026	
1027	  /* Check that this is the correct response to this command */
1028	
1029	  else if ((cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) != MMCSD_R1_RESPONSE &&
1030	           (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) != MMCSD_R1B_RESPONSE &&
1031	           (cmd & MMCSD_RESPONSE_MASK) != MMCSD_R6_RESPONSE) {
1032	    mcerr("ERROR: Wrong response CMD=%04x\n", cmd);
1033	    ret = -EINVAL;
1034	  } else
1035	#endif
1036	  {
1037	    /* Check if a timeout or CRC error occurred */
1038	
1039	    regval = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
1040	    if ((regval & SDMMC_INT_RTO) != 0) {
1041	      mcerr("ERROR: Command timeout: %08x\n", regval);
1042	      ret = -ETIMEDOUT;
1043	    } else if ((regval & SDMMC_INT_RCRC) != 0) {
1044	      mcerr("ERROR: CRC failure: %08x\n", regval);
1045	      ret = -EIO;
1046	    }
1047	  }
1048	
1049	  /* Clear all pending message completion events and return the R1/R6
1050	   * response.
1051	   */
1052	
1053	  esp32s3_putreg(SDCARD_RESPDONE_CLEAR | SDCARD_CMDDONE_CLEAR,
1054	                 ESP32S3_SDMMC_RINTSTS);
1055	  *rshort = esp32s3_getreg(ESP32S3_SDMMC_RESP0);
1056	  mcinfo("CRC=%04x\n", *rshort);
1057	
1058	  return ret;
1059	}

1197	/****************************************************************************
1198	 * Name: sdio_initialize
1199	 *
1200	 * Description:
1201	 *   Initialize SDIO for the given slot.  Returns an SDIO device interface
1202	 *   instance that can be used with the NuttX SDIO/MMC/SD stack.
1203	 *
1204	 * Input Parameters:

1206	 *            ESP-Hosted SDIO to ESP32-C6)

1210	 *
1211	 ****************************************************************************/
1212	
1213	struct sdio_dev_s *sdio_initialize(int slotno) {
1214	  struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s *priv;
1215	  sdmmc_dev_t *hw = SDMMC_HW;
1216	  irqstate_t flags;
1217	
1218	  /* Validate slot number */
1219	
1220	  if (slotno < 0 || slotno > 1) {
1221	    snerr("ERROR: Invalid SDMMC slot %d\n", slotno);
1222	    return NULL;
1223	  }
1224	
1225	  /* Check if the requested slot is enabled */
1226	
1227	  if (slotno == 0 && !IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT0)) {
1228	    snerr("ERROR: SDMMC slot 0 not enabled\n");
1229	    return NULL;
1230	  }
1231	
1232	  if (slotno == 1 && !IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1)) {
1233	    snerr("ERROR: SDMMC slot 1 not enabled\n");
1234	    return NULL;
1235	  }
1236	
1237	  /* Allocate the device structure */
1238	
1239	  priv = kmm_zalloc(sizeof(struct esp32p4_sdmmc_dev_s));
1240	  if (priv == NULL) {
1241	    snerr("ERROR: Failed to allocate SDMMC device\n");
1242	    return NULL;
1243	  }
1244	
1245	  /* Copy the operations table */
1246	
1247	  memcpy(&priv->dev, &g_sdmmc_ops, sizeof(g_sdmmc_ops));
1248	
1249	  /* Initialize the slot */
1250	
1251	  priv->slot = slotno;
1252	
1253	  /* Set up pin configuration for slot 1 */
1254	
1255	  if (slotno == 1) {
1256	    priv->pin_clk = CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1_PIN_CLK;
1257	    priv->pin_cmd = CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1_PIN_CMD;
1258	    priv->pin_d0 = CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1_PIN_D0;
1259	    priv->pin_d1 = CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1_PIN_D1;
1260	    priv->pin_d2 = CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1_PIN_D2;
1261	    priv->pin_d3 = CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1_PIN_D3;
1262	  }
1263	
1264	  /* Set IRQ number */
1265	
1266	  priv->irq = ESP_IRQ_SDIO_HOST;
1267	
1268	  /* Initialize synchronization primitives */
1269	
1270	  spin_lock_init(&priv->lock);
1271	  nxsem_init(&priv->waitsem, 0, 0);
1272	
1273	  /* Allocate DMA descriptor (must be 64-byte aligned for ESP32P4) */
1274	
1275	  priv->dma_desc = kmm_memalign(SDMMC_DMA_DESC_ALIGN, sizeof(sdmmc_desc_t));
1276	  if (priv->dma_desc == NULL) {
1277	    snerr("ERROR: Failed to allocate DMA descriptor\n");
1278	    kmm_free(priv);
1279	    return NULL;
1280	  }
1281	
1282	  flags = spin_lock_irqsave(&priv->lock);
1283	
1284	  /* Enable SDMMC bus clock via HP_SYS_CLKRST */
1285	
1286	  sdmmc_ll_enable_bus_clock(0, true);
1287	
1288	  /* Reset the SDMMC module via LP_AON_CLKRST */
1289	
1290	  sdmmc_ll_reset_register(0);
1291	
1292	  /* Reset controller, DMA, and FIFO via HAL */
1293	
1294	  sdmmc_ll_reset_controller(hw);
1295	  sdmmc_ll_reset_dma(hw);
1296	  sdmmc_ll_reset_fifo(hw);
1297	
1298	  /* Configure pins */
1299	
1300	  esp_sdmmc_configure_pins(priv);
1301	
1302	  /* Set initial clock to 400 kHz (identification mode) */
1303	
1304	  esp_sdmmc_set_frequency(priv, SDMMC_INIT_FREQ);
1305	
1306	  /* Set default bus width to 1-bit */
1307	
1308	  hw->ctype.card_width = 0;
1309	  priv->buswidth = 1;
1310	
1311	  /* Set data timeout */
1312	
1313	  sdmmc_ll_set_data_timeout(hw, SDMMC_DEFAULT_DATA_TIMEOUT);
1314	
1315	  /* Set response timeout */
1316	
1317	  sdmmc_ll_set_response_timeout(hw, SDMMC_DEFAULT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT);
1318	
1319	  /* Debounce */
1320	
1321	  hw->debnce.val = 0xffffffu;
1322	
1323	  /* Clear all interrupts */
1324	
1325	  hw->rintsts.val = 0xffffffffu;
1326	
1327	  /* Disable all interrupts (will be enabled in attach) */
1328	
1329	  hw->intmask.val = 0;
1330	
1331	  /* Enable DMA mode in controller */
1332	
1333	  hw->ctrl.dma_reset = 1;
1334	  while (hw->ctrl.dma_reset) {
1335	    /* Wait for DMA reset to complete */
1336	  }
1337	
1338	  /* Enable internal DMA controller (IDMAC) */
1339	
1340	  hw->ctrl.dma_enable = 1;
1341	  hw->ctrl.use_internal_dma = 1;
1342	  hw->bmod.enable = 1;
1343	  hw->bmod.fb = 1;
1344	
1345	  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&priv->lock, flags);
1346	
1347	  sninfo("SDMMC slot %d initialized\n", slotno);
1348	
1349	  return &priv->dev;
1350	}

Now I see there are TWO SDMMC implementations in the chip layer:

/****************************************************************************

 *
 * This file initializes the ESP-Hosted protocol stack which provides
 * WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity via the onboard ESP32-C6 co-processor.
 *
 * The communication path is:
 *   ESP32-P4 (host) <--SDIO--> ESP32-C6 (slave/co-processor)
 *
 * The ESP-Hosted stack handles:
 * - SDIO transport initialization
 * - RPC protocol for WiFi/BT control
 * - Network device registration (WiFi STA/AP)
 * - Bluetooth HCI transport (optional)
 *

#include <nuttx/config.h>

#include <debug.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <syslog.h>

#include "esp_hosted_port.h"
#include "esp_hosted_netdev.h"

/****************************************************************************
 * Public Functions
 ****************************************************************************/

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: board_esp_hosted_initialize
 *
 * Description:
 *   Initialize the ESP-Hosted protocol stack for WiFi/BT connectivity
 *   via the onboard ESP32-C6 co-processor.
 *
 *   This function:
 *   1. Initializes the ESP-Hosted port layer (OS abstraction)
 *   2. Registers the WiFi network device (which starts the SDIO transport)
 *
 *   The SDIO transport internally:
 *   - Calls sdio_initialize(CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED_SDIO_SLOT) to get SDIO device
 *   - Initializes the SDIO card (CCCR registers, function enable)
 *   - Sets up the RPC protocol for WiFi/BT commands
 *   - Creates the network interface (wlan0)
 *
 *   Prerequisites:
 *   - SDMMC slot 1 GPIO matrix pins must be configured first
 *     (done by board_sdmmc_initialize())
 *   - CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED and CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED_SDIO must be enabled
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   Zero (OK) is returned on success; A negated errno value is returned
 *   to indicate the nature of any failure.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int board_esp_hosted_initialize(void)
{
  int ret;

  /* Step 1: Initialize the ESP-Hosted port layer.
   * This sets up OS abstraction (threads, mutexes, queues, timers).
   */

  ret = esp_hosted_port_init();
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR: esp_hosted_port_init failed: %d\n", ret);
      return ret;
    }

  syslog(LOG_INFO, "ESP-Hosted port layer initialized\n");

  /* Step 2: Register the ESP-Hosted network device.
   * This internally calls esp_hosted_init() which:
   * - Initializes the SDIO transport (calls hosted_sdio_init())
   * - Performs SDIO card initialization (CCCR, function enable)
   * - Starts the RPC protocol for WiFi/BT control
   * - Registers the network device as wlan0
   */

  ret = esp_hosted_netdev_register();
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR: esp_hosted_netdev_register failed: %d\n", ret);
      return ret;
    }

  syslog(LOG_INFO, "ESP-Hosted network device registered\n");

  return OK;
}

180	/****************************************************************************
181	 * Name: board_sdmmc_initialize
182	 *
183	 * Description:
184	 *   Initialize SDMMC subsystem for the ESP32-P4 contest board.
185	 *
186	 *   This function initializes:
187	 *   - Slot 0: External TF card (uses IOMUX dedicated pins)
188	 *   - Slot 1: ESP-Hosted SDIO to onboard ESP32-C6 (uses GPIO matrix)
189	 *
190	 *   Slot 0 is registered as MMC/SD device at /dev/mmcsd0.
191	 *   Slot 1 is used by esp-hosted for WiFi/BT via ESP32-C6.
192	 *
193	 * Returned Value:
194	 *   Zero (OK) is returned on success; A negated errno value is returned
195	 *   to indicate the nature of any failure.
196	 *
197	 ****************************************************************************/
198	
199	int board_sdmmc_initialize(void)
200	{
201	  struct sdio_dev_s *sdio;
202	  int ret = OK;
203	
204	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT0
205	  /* Initialize SDMMC slot 0 for external TF card (IOMUX pins) */
206	
207	  sdio = sdio_initialize(0);
208	  if (!sdio)
209	    {
210	      syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR: Failed to initialize SDMMC slot 0 (TF card)\n");
211	      return -ENODEV;
212	    }
213	
214	  /* Register the SD card driver at /dev/mmcsd0 */
215	
216	  ret = mmcsd_slotinitialize(0, sdio);
217	  if (ret < 0)
218	    {
219	      syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR: Failed to register MMC/SD slot 0: %d\n", ret);
220	      return ret;
221	    }
222	
223	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "SDMMC slot 0 (TF card) initialized\n");
224	#endif /* CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT0 */
225	
226	#ifdef CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1
227	  /* Configure GPIO matrix pins for slot 1 before initializing SDIO.
228	   * Slot 1 uses GPIO matrix (not IOMUX) for ESP-Hosted SDIO connection.
229	   * Pin configuration must happen before sdio_initialize() is called.
230	   */
231	
232	  board_sdmmc_slot1_configure_pins();
233	
234	  /* Initialize SDMMC slot 1 for ESP-Hosted SDIO to ESP32-C6 */
235	
236	  sdio = sdio_initialize(1);
237	  if (!sdio)
238	    {
239	      syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR: Failed to initialize SDMMC slot 1 "
240	             "(ESP-Hosted SDIO)\n");
241	      return -ENODEV;
242	    }
243	
244	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "SDMMC slot 1 (ESP-Hosted SDIO) initialized\n");
245	#endif /* CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1 */
246	
247	  return ret;
248	}

## Summary of Changes

### Files Created (4 new files):

1. **`board/contest_board/src/board_sdmmc.h`** - Header for SDMMC board initialization
2. **`board/contest_board/src/board_sdmmc.c`** - SDMMC initialization for:

   - Slot 1: ESP-Hosted SDIO to ESP32-C6 (GPIO matrix pins)
3. **`board/contest_board/src/board_esp_hosted.h`** - Header for ESP-Hosted initialization
4. **`board/contest_board/src/board_esp_hosted.c`** - ESP-Hosted protocol initialization:
   - Port layer (OS abstraction)
   - Network device registration (WiFi STA/AP)

### Files Modified (3 files):

1. **`board/contest_board/src/board_boot.c`** - Added calls to `board_sdmmc_initialize()` and `board_esp_hosted_initialize()` in `openvela_board_initialize()`
2. **`board/contest_board/src/CMakeLists.txt`** - Added conditional compilation for `board_sdmmc.c` and `board_esp_hosted.c`
3. **`board/contest_board/Kconfig`** - Added GPIO pin configuration options for SDMMC slot 1

## Architecture

```
Boot Flow:
openvela_board_initialize()
  ├── board_sdmmc_initialize()         [CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC]
  │   ├── sdio_initialize(0)           → TF card (IOMUX)
  │   ├── mmcsd_slotinitialize(0)      → /dev/mmcsd0
  │   ├── board_sdmmc_slot1_configure_pins() → GPIO matrix
  │   └── sdio_initialize(1)           → ESP-Hosted SDIO
  │
  └── board_esp_hosted_initialize()    [CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED]
      ├── esp_hosted_port_init()       → OS abstraction
      └── esp_hosted_netdev_register() → WiFi network device
```

## Required Kconfig Configuration

To enable this functionality, the defconfig needs:

```
# SDMMC support
CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC=y
CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT0=y          # TF card
CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC_SLOT1=y          # ESP-Hosted SDIO

# ESP-Hosted support
CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED=y
CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED_SDIO=y
CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED_SDIO_SLOT=1         # Use SDMMC slot 1
CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED_CP_TARGET_ESP32C6=y # Slave is ESP32-C6
```

## Potential Issue

The chip-level `esp32p4_sdmmc.c` driver uses a **single global instance** (`g_sdiodev`). When `sdio_initialize(1)` is called after `sdio_initialize(0)`, it returns the same global instance with `slot=1`, which may affect slot 0's functionality. 

If both slots need to work simultaneously, the chip driver would need to be modified to support multiple instances. For now, this implementation assumes either:
- Only one slot is used at a time, OR
- The chip driver is enhanced to support dual slots

已完成 ESP32-P4 SDIO 板级支持的添加。以下是实现内容：

## 新增文件

1. **`esp32p4_board_sdmmc.h`** / **`esp32p4_board_sdmmc.c`**
   - Slot 0: TF 卡 (IOMUX 引脚，由 chip 驱动配置)
   - Slot 1: ESP-Hosted SDIO (GPIO 矩阵引脚，板级配置)
   - 引脚配置来自 Kconfig: CLK=14, CMD=15, D0=16, D1=17, D2=18, D3=19

2. **`esp32p4_board_esp_hosted.h`** / **`esp32p4_board_esp_hosted.c`**
   - 调用 `esp_hosted_port_init()` 初始化 OS 抽象层
   - 调用 `esp_hosted_netdev_register()` 注册 wlan0 网络设备

## 修改文件

3. **`esp32p4_bringup.c`**
   - 添加了 SDMMC 和 ESP-Hosted 的初始化调用
   - 顺序：先 SDMMC (slot 1)，再 ESP-Hosted

4. **`CMakeLists.txt`**
   - 添加条件编译：`CONFIG_ESP32P4_SDMMC` 和 `CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED`

## 关键设计

- **GPIO 矩阵配置**：Slot 1 使用 GPIO 矩阵路由，在调用 `sdio_initialize(1)` 前配置
- **引脚属性**：
  - CLK: `OUTPUT_FUNCTION_1` (输出)
  - CMD: `OUTPUT_FUNCTION_1 | INPUT_FUNCTION_1 | OPEN_DRAIN | PULLUP` (双向开漏)
  - D0-D3: `OUTPUT_FUNCTION_1 | INPUT_FUNCTION_1 | PULLUP` (双向)

所有必要的 Kconfig 配置已在 `esp_hosted` defconfig 中存在，无需额外修改。
